layout_notes: 720x1280 vertical stream layout. Top ~4%: thin overlay strip with a viewer count box ("2,335") at the top-left. y ~4-36%: face cam (full width). y ~36-69%: the BGMI game feed, a 16:9 picture whose left and right edges are cropped off, so anything at the far left of the game (e.g. the big rank number on the result screen) is cut. y ~69-100%: static overlay (Kick link, UPI id, Instagram handle, subscribe badge). Classic HUD: 'Eliminations N' box at x ~0.02-0.15, y ~0.365-0.38 of the frame (left of the BGMI logo). TDM HUD: top-left K/D value and a fist icon with the streamer's kills (x ~0.0-0.1, y ~0.37), team scores and 'Goal: 40' at top centre. 'starting soon' and 'ending soon' cards at the start and end. Stream-overlay animations (a chicken-pan 'Winner Winner Chicken Dinner' card, an 'MVP' card, a logo sting) pop over the game around match ends.
